Messages.Author: Franz
Messages.Body:
This is kind of a dumb one, but I need official clarification for a friend of mine.

So, here it is: Can you choose Coma as your strike against an ally (I presume no, as per cardtext). If you can, what happens?

Messages.Author: Klaital
Messages.Body: No you cannot, coma can only target opposing vampire, allies aren't vampires. Same as how you can't play taste of vitae or disarm against allies either.

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
Name: Coma
[Sabbat:U, SW:U, CE:U, BH:PM3, Third:U]
Cardtype: Combat
Cost: 3 blood
Discipline: Dementation
[dem] Strike: opposing vampire goes into torpor.
[DEM] As above, and that vampire does not untap as normal during his or her controller's next untap phase.

Correct, can't Coma against an ally.
